Ursus americanus.name: black bear
Ursus americanus.note: usually flees; never store food in shelter, fight back if attacked in a predatory encounter

Ursus arctos.name: brown bear
Ursus arctos.note: grizzly; carry bear spray, do not run, play dead only in defensive encounters

Ursus maritimus.name: polar bear
Ursus maritimus.note: actively predatory toward humans; any encounter is an emergency

Puma concolor.name: cougar
Puma concolor.note: appear large, never run, fight back if attacked

Canis lupus.name: gray wolf
Canis lupus.note: avoid, do not feed; healthy wolves avoid humans

Alces alces.name: moose
Alces alces.note: rutting bulls and cows with calves charge; more injuries than bears in Alaska

Bison bison.name: american bison
Bison bison.note: unpredictable, goring risk; stay 25 m+ away

Cervus canadensis.name: elk
Cervus canadensis.note: dangerous in rut (Sep-Oct) and calving season (May-Jun)

Alligator mississippiensis.name: american alligator
Alligator mississippiensis.note: never swim in gator water; stay 10 m+ from bank edges

Crocodylus acutus.name: american crocodile
Crocodylus acutus.note: shy but large; same water discipline as alligator

Agkistrodon contortrix.name: eastern copperhead
Agkistrodon contortrix.note: venomous; most-bitten snake in eastern US; freeze, locate, back away

Agkistrodon piscivorus.name: cottonmouth
Agkistrodon piscivorus.note: venomous semi-aquatic; gapes white mouth as warning

Crotalus atrox.name: western diamond-backed rattlesnake
Crotalus atrox.note: venomous; give wide berth, do not handle dead snakes

Crotalus horridus.name: timber rattlesnake
Crotalus horridus.note: venomous; basks on trail rocks and ledges

Crotalus scutulatus.name: mohave rattlesnake
Crotalus scutulatus.note: venomous, neurotoxic populations; most dangerous NA rattlesnake

Sistrurus catenatus.name: massasauga
Sistrurus catenatus.note: venomous pygmy rattlesnake relative; wet prairies

Micrurus fulvius.name: eastern coral snake
Micrurus fulvius.note: venomous neurotoxic; red-yellow bands touch; do NOT cut or suck bites

Heloderma suspectum.name: gila monster
Heloderma suspectum.note: venomous lizard; painful chew bite; do not handle

Rhinella marina.name: cane toad
Rhinella marina.note: bufotoxin; keep pets away, wash hands after contact

Loxosceles reclusa.name: brown recluse
Loxosceles reclusa.note: necrotic venom; shake out stored clothing and bedding

Centruroides vittatus.name: striped bark scorpion
Centruroides vittatus.note: painful sting; check shoes in the south-central US

Centruroides sculpturatus.name: arizona bark scorpion
Centruroides sculpturatus.note: medically significant sting; only lethal scorpion in the US

Vespula squamosa.name: southern yellowjacket
Vespula squamosa.note: aggressive ground nests; carry antihistamines if allergic

Amblyomma americanum.name: lone star tick
Amblyomma americanum.note: aggressive biter; alpha-gal and ehrlichiosis vector; daily tick checks

Ixodes scapularis.name: black-legged tick
Ixodes scapularis.note: Lyme vector; permethrin trousers, 24h removal window
